rationale_overall: No current holding shows a thesis breach as of 2022-12-31: AI mega-caps (AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA) are still supported by the AI wave's early-surge phase (ChatGPT's Nov 30 2022 public launch signals the wave is building, not cresting); ISRG's Q3 2022 da Vinci procedure volume (+20% YoY) confirms the demographics/healthcare thesis; FRO's Q3 2022 results and tanker-rate spike amid EU Russian-oil sanctions confirm the tanker/geopolitical thesis; SMR, RKLB, IONQ, LMT, ITA, and SPY show no negative signal in the lookback window. Two adds fill named-but-uncovered wave gaps: ROK gives the watchlist its first robotics/automation exposure on strong Q4 FY2022 results, and GD adds a defense prime alongside LMT/ITA (geopolitical bucket now at 3 of the 4-ticker cap) on strong backlog plus the Dec 2022 omnibus defense budget increase. No removes proposed; watchlist grows from 12 to 14, still well under the 24 cap.
